issue.title: Regression: [Snappi] Tests using dynamic port selection logic are getting skipped incorrectly

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Previous Working Version

202411

### Steps to Reproduce

Run tests from `tests/snappi_tests` using `tgen_port_info` fixture (you'll see that these tests are getting skipped)

### Impact of this regression

Test cases won't be running as they were getting skipped incorrectly.

https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/15069 has introduced dynamic port selection which is achieved by fixture tgen_port_info.

With above change all the test cases using tgen_port_info are getting skipped incorrectly with signature got empty parameter set ['tgen_port_info'], function ...

More details:
tgen_port_info fixture (see [get_snappi_testbed_metadata](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/202505/tests/conftest.py#L1493-L1513)) depends on metadata tests/metadata/snappi_tests which is supposed to be populated by pretest [test_update_snappi_testbed_metadata](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/202505/tests/test_pretest.py#L216)

But this pretest is getting skipped due to check pytest_require(("tgen" in (request.config.getoption("--topology") or "")) see https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/202505/tests/test_pretest.py#L220-L221, this check expects "tgen" in topology which makes sense for snappi topologies (as we pass tgen or multidut-tgen to the run_tests.sh -t argument). But for pretests pytest will be called with --topology util (see [UTIL_TOPOLOGY_OPTIONS](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/202505/tests/run_tests.sh#L306)) instead of TEST_TOPOLOGY_OPTIONS thus causing above pretest to get skipped along with snappi testcases using tgen_port_info fixture.

Fixes # (issue) #19277
